statements.text: Pot 1 should grow best because the plant has both sunlight and adequate water.
Pot 2 should grow as well as Pot 1 because sunlight alone is enough.
Pot 3 should grow as well as Pot 1 because water alone is enough.

stem:
Qadir grows three similar saplings.
Pot 1 gets sunlight and water each day.
Pot 2 gets sunlight but no water.
Pot 3 gets water but stays in the dark.

Which statements are correct?

teacher.key_rationale: A plant grows best when it has both sunlight and adequate water; either one alone is not enough.
